name: OAUTH_LANE_READ_TIMEOUT_20261108
comment: ANCHOR: OAUTH_LANE_READ_TIMEOUT_20261108 — LQ-20261107-978: a read timeout is the caller's deadline, not the proxy's state; an 'unreachable' cooldown no longer hides a lane whose /health reports ready, so one 30 s budget cannot turn into 'no governed cloud lane available' for the rest of the run (iris_run_log id 264). A 429 cooldown is unchanged.
